view.emptyHint: Once you log your first runs, your fitness trend, weekly km, race predictions and records show up here.

trends.title: Trends
trends.formHint: Fitness: training over the last 6 weeks. Fatigue: training over the last 7 days.

formTrend.up: Your fitness is up compared with a month ago.
formTrend.down: Your fitness is down compared with a month ago.
formTrend.stable: Your fitness is stable compared with a month ago.

calibrating.label: Calibrating
calibrating.text: A few more runs and the reading becomes stable.

fresh.label: Well recovered
fresh.text: You have margin: a good time for a hard session.

balanced.label: Balanced
balanced.text: Fitness and fatigue are in balance.

strained.label: Carrying some load
strained.text: Recent work is heavy: look after your recovery.

fatigued.label: Fatigued
fatigued.text: Better a light day or a rest day.

formStatus.title: Fitness status

intense.label: Ready to push
intense.text: Your recovery and sleep say you can handle a hard session.

ready.label: Ready
ready.text: Good conditions to train as planned.

empty.text: Log your first runs to see how you're doing.

formStatus.stale: Your watch hasn't synced in a few days, so for now only your activities are counted.

prompt.fast: In my last speed sessions I've been consistently faster than the planned paces. Can you update the paces in my plan?
prompt.slow: In my last speed sessions I've been struggling to hold the planned paces. Can you review them?

pace.legend: Seconds per km versus planned pace: − faster, + slower.

trendText.fast: In your recent speed sessions you've been consistently faster than planned: it may be time to update your paces.
trendText.slow: In your recent speed sessions you've been struggling to hold the planned paces: better to review them.

forma.title: Fitness status

summary.none: No clear change over the last 4 weeks, or more data is needed to see it.
summary.comparison: Comparison between the last 2 weeks and the 2 weeks a month ago (the gray bands in the charts).

labels.efficiency: pace at the same heart rate

load.title: Load
load.calibrating: 7-day load: you still need 3 weeks of history to compare it with your average.
load.chartHint: Fitness: training over the last 6 weeks. Fatigue: training over the last 7 days. Freshness = fitness − fatigue.

forma.noWatch: Connect your watch (Zepp app or Intervals.icu) in settings to see VO₂max, sleep, resting HR, HRV and stress.

notes.title: Good to know
notes.zepp: Zepp app data arrives when you sync your watch: days without a sync stay empty instead of being estimated.
notes.hrv: HRV only comes from Intervals.icu: the watch app can't read it.
notes.missing: Zepp recovery time, REM and light sleep phases and skin temperature are not shown here: the first has a unit not yet verified, and the watch app doesn't send the others.
notes.metersPerBeat: Meters per beat: only easy runs and long runs of at least 20 minutes, without intervals, threshold or tests; heat and hills lower it.
